en.t: The New Year came to Suma Bay.
The spring days passed slowly, and his rough dwelling lay in silence.

units.source_text: 去年新种的小樱花树隐隐约约地开花了。

en.t: The small cherry trees newly planted the previous year had begun to bloom faintly.

units.source_text: 每当日丽风和之时，源氏公子追思种种往事，常是黯然泣下。

en.t: Whenever the sun was bright and the wind was gentle, Prince Genji would think back on many past events and often weep in sorrow.
The twentieth day of the second month had passed.

units.source_text: 去年离京，正是这般时候。

en.t: It had been just around this time the previous year that he left the capital.

units.source_text: 诸亲友惜别时的面影，憬然在目，深可怀念。

en.t: The faces of all his relatives and friends as they grieved at parting rose vividly before his eyes, filling him with deep longing.
He imagined that the cherry blossoms at the Southern Palace must now be in full bloom.

units.source_text: 当年花宴上桐壶院的声音笑貌，朱雀帝的清秀之姿，以及公子自己所作诗篇朗诵时的情形，都活跃眼前，便吟诗道：

en.t: The voice and smiling face of the Kiritsubo Emperor at that year's flower banquet, the graceful figure of Emperor Suzaku, and even the scene of Genji himself reciting the poem he had composed all came vividly before his eyes, and he chanted:
